summary: Fold only the visible agents collection cards on cold reads

replay.detail: Existing claims and reducers remain authoritative. Cold unfiltered collection reads reuse ordered page references and fold only the requested prefix. No replay is needed.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, claim kinds or stored formats change.

rules.detail: Authorization, ownership and admission rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Snapshot rows, display order, has-more behavior and existing HTTP cursors are unchanged. Status-filtered windows still filter the complete live-overlay result. Partial windows inherit their projection's queue lease deadline and retain their FIFO reader grant when selected-prefix cache coverage is valid.

downtime.detail: The read-path change requires no migration or coordinated shutdown.

recovery.detail: The immutable projection entries remain rebuildable from the store with the existing snapshot, local-frontier, coverage and queue-expiry fences.
